name: Takar the Seer
summary: Takar the Seer is an elusive human hermit encamped deep within the Barrens, east of Camp Taurajo. Despite sitting entirely within Horde-dominated territory, he maintains allegiance to the Alliance and assists certain travelers with esoteric occult knowledge.

sections.title: A Recluse in the Savannah
sections.body: Dwelling alone beneath a simple tent east of Camp Taurajo, Takar the Seer seems out of place amid the dry plains of the Barrens. Surrounding lands are watched constantly by tauren braves and orc patrols, yet Takar remains undisturbed in his remote clearing. Hostile to curious Horde interlopers but rarely eager to initiate violence, he keeps a sharp eye on the horizon and prefers solitude. His isolated existence suggests deliberate seclusion, far from the bustling politics of Stormwind.

sections.title: Occult Counsel
sections.body: Though solitary, Takar is not entirely detached from the wider world. Initiates of darker arts—particularly Alliance warlocks sent from the Eastern Kingdoms—seek his cryptic guidance when attempting to bind dangerous otherworldly entities. His deep understanding of unseen forces and soulcraft makes his remote camp a vital, if perilous, pilgrimage site for practitioners looking to bind and command demons.

faq.q: Why is a human seer living alone in the Barrens?
aliases: why is takar in the barrens
faq.answer: Takar has never said why. He keeps a lone camp east of Camp Taurajo with no Alliance outpost anywhere near, and the warlocks who seek him out come for his knowledge of demons, not his story.

faq.q: Is Takar hostile to Horde players?
faq.answer: Yes, Takar is aligned with the Alliance and will appear hostile to Horde adventurers. However, he is not overly aggressive and generally will not strike unless provoked or approached too closely.

faq.q: What brings Alliance adventurers to his camp?
faq.answer: Certain Alliance seekers, particularly warlocks pursuing binding rituals for powerful demons such as the Succubus, are directed to Takar. He provides cryptic instructions and insight into acquiring the reagents necessary to summon and dominate these entities.

angles.text: For Alliance warlocks, Takar is a vital contact in Kalimdor, guiding initiates through dangerous rites to summon and bind a succubus into their service.
Finding a friendly human face deep in the heart of the Horde's core territory provides a rare, albeit solitary, contact point in central Kalimdor.
